_about: AUTHORED by the game team (game balance, not ARGUS data). Coins per danger level, the same at every monument: more serious dangers come with more coins, the way real monitoring budgets grow with the risk. Levels are the ABC priority labels. Kept in steps of one: the cheapest full-score network costs 2-8 coins, so every level keeps at least 4 spare coins, while at most levels buying every helpful card still does not fit (both checked by web/tests/logic.test.ts). Needs review after the playtest.
